question: The greatest number of people who have been displaced internally in their home country are in
solution:
The correct answer is "**Ethiopia**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **sixth**, **seventh **and **last **paragraph of the passage mentions there are more than** 48 million** internally displaced people. The highest increase in the number of internally displaced people happened in Africa. Civil war in **Ethiopia**, Africa's second most-populated country, has sparked a wave of displacement in a region that was already facing what the UNHCR calls "a full-scale humanitarian crisis." All in all, **more than a million** Ethiopian people had to leave their homes behind last year, the UNHCR says.
 
• **Option 1** is incorrect as **Turkey **is a **host nation** mentioned in the given passage.
 
• The **fifth paragraph **of the passage mentions that with **3.7 million** displaced people now within its borders, 92% of its refugees have come from neighbouring **Syria**.** Option 2** is not the correct answer as the number of people displaced over the last 10 years is lower in comparison to Ethiopia where more than a million have been displaced over the last year.
 
• **Option 3** is also incorrect as the number of people displaced in Afghanistan is lesser than in Ethiopia as mentioned in the **third **paragraph.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 4.**
